x.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished premium social media header image for X for the Saudi B2B sports-technology brand نرفد. Canvas exact requested size 1500x500 pixels, panoramic 3:1, full bleed, NO framing, no mockup of a social media page.
Input image 1 is the authentic existing brand logo, supporting identity reference; faithfully reproduce the Arabic logo and green emblem, do not invent or translate it. Its black/transparent surrounding canvas is not part of the logo. Preserve the Arabic tagline if readable and reproduce it correctly: "السند التقني للمؤسسات الرياضية". No additional English brand wordmark.
Art direction: sophisticated dark architectural sports technology brand, matte charcoal #1c1c1c, offwhite #ededed, restrained emerald #3ecf8e, subtle graphite texture. At left-center, a beautiful miniature isometric connected sports facility made of sculpted dark architectural blocks: padel court outlines, small gym pavilion and clubhouse connected by a single precise emerald path. Very refined realistic 3D materials with soft studio light, no sci-fi glow overload, no cartoon clipart. Place this scene in the left half above the profile photo overlap zone, with atmospheric shapes extending off the left edge. Keep bottom-left 28% width by 30% height completely free of critical content for the account avatar.
At center-right put a clean, well-spaced Arabic typography composition. The authentic logo sits above, comfortably inside safe margins. Under it set exact large Arabic headline as TWO lines: "كل تفاصيل مؤسستك." then "في منظومة واحدة." in a confident geometric Arabic sans like Tajawal, first line offwhite second line emerald. Small website under it: "www.narfid.com". Keep overall text at least 80px from top/right, 90px from bottom, balanced large whitespace. Arabic must be correctly connected, legible and exact. Avoid additional slogans, UI screenshots, fake software metrics, people, generic computer icons, social platform logos, feature lists, numerals, badges, watermarks. Polished editorial design with deliberate alignment and excellent legibility, minimal high-end branding.

linkedin.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete very wide LinkedIn COMPANY PAGE cover (not personal profile, not a mockup). Target exact canvas 1512 x 256 pixels, aspect ratio 5.90625:1, extremely shallow panoramic banner. This ratio is crucial. Full bleed with no external frame or white margins.
Input image 1 is the existing authentic Arabic نرفد brand logo, identity reference/supporting insert. Reproduce faithfully the Arabic white wordmark, green emblem, and small existing tagline "السند التقني للمؤسسات الرياضية"; no English wordmark, no redesigned logo.
Saudi B2B sports technology brand for owners/managers. Premium architectural 3D editorial art direction. Charcoal #1c1c1c, graphite, soft offwhite #ededed, emerald #3ecf8e. A refined continuous emerald ribbon connects a miniature dark padel court, a gym pavilion and a clubhouse as an isometric sports facility on the LEFT HALF. Precise restrained miniature architecture, realistic stone, glass, court markings and subtle trees, warm window illumination against charcoal, gently fading into clean background near center. Same visual identity as a high-end sports-technology provider, not real customer documentation. No people, no fabricated software screens, no numbers, no feature list.
All critical art and copy must be confined to a shallow horizontal band centered vertically: it must work as a 6:1 crop if needed. Keep generous negative space at far edges and entire bottom-left corner clear for page avatar. On center-right create ONE concise horizontal Arabic brand message: authentic Arabic logo at approx 72% of canvas width, and exact headline "كل تفاصيل مؤسستك، في منظومة واحدة." arranged as a clean ONE-LINE slogan beneath or just left of the logo. Set confident legible Arabic geometric sans, properly shaped RTL letters, white and emerald selective emphasis. Website "www.narfid.com" small and tasteful. This is a very short banner: don't stack many lines, keep logo and headline compact within middle 60% height, with plenty of vertical breathing room. Rightmost 10% stays decorative, nothing near lower-right corner. Precise polished typographic alignment. No extra wording, no social icons, no company location/address, no promotional badge, no image-type labels, no watermark. Modern subtle curving graphic edges inspired by emblem. Strong legibility and understated technical sophistication.
